verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with API keys, a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and an MCP server, but no official SDK or client library. The spec page only says it can be used to 'generate client libraries', which leaves SDK creation to the user. That is a developer building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit; the MCP server belongs to a separate story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
